scenes.name: READINGS
lines: Three pointers start near zero. In one run each can end to the left or the right.
三支指针都从零附近出发。每轮结束时，它们可以停在零点左边或右边。
Multiply the signed readings and average over all runs. Divide by the product of the three coupling strengths.
把有正负号的读数相乘，再对所有轮次求平均，最后除以三个耦合强度的乘积。
Abbott and colleagues asked if the weak limit stays above or at minus one eighth, even with more than two measurements.
Abbott 等人问，即使测量超过两次，弱极限是否仍大于等于负八分之一？

scenes.name: ORDER
lines: A projection keeps the part of an arrow along a line or inside a plane.
投影保留箭头沿直线或在平面内的分量。
Start at zero, one. Project to the diagonal and then to the horizontal axis. You reach one half, zero.
从坐标 (0,1) 出发，先投到对角线，再投到横轴，得到 (1/2,0)。
Reverse these two operations and you reach zero immediately.
反过来先投到横轴，立刻得到零。
The pointer calculation brings in one projection at a time and averages the two multiplication orders.
计算指针系数时，每次加入一个投影，并平均两种乘法次序。

scenes.name: WITNESS
lines: Now use three dimensions and start along the third axis.
现在转到三维空间，从第三坐标轴的单位向量出发。
One plane projection averages the last two coordinates. The other averages the first and third. Add their two orders.
一个平面投影平均后两个坐标，另一个平均第一、第三坐标。把两个次序的结果相加。
The first projection, onto a line, gives two negative coordinates and one positive coordinate.
第一个投影保留一条直线，给出两个负坐标和一个正坐标。
Take half the dot product. The two negative contributions dominate, giving minus one sixth, below minus one eighth.
取点积的一半。两个负的贡献占优，得到负六分之一，低于负八分之一。

scenes.name: ONE STEP
lines: To find the sharp floor, suppose the current eigenvalues are between minus c and one.
要找精确下界，设当前特征值都在负 c 和一之间。
Let s be the length of the projected unit state. It ranges from zero to one.
令 s 为单位态经过投影后的长度。它介于零和一之间。
The smallest possible expectation is bounded by this quadratic. Its lowest point gives the next floor.
这个二次函数从下方控制期望。它的最低点给出下一步的下界。
A projection in a plane spanned by the current bottom direction and a fresh unit direction can attain the bound.
用当前最低特征值的方向与一个新方向构成平面。在该平面选择投影，就能达到下界。

scenes.name: LENGTHS
lines: Start with a floor of zero for one projection. For two it is minus one eighth.
一次投影的下界是零。两次投影时，下界是负八分之一。
For three it is minus eighty-one over four hundred forty-eight. The rational example already breaks the conjectured bound.
三次投影的精确下界是负四百四十八分之八十一。有理数反例已经打破了猜想的下界。
The sharp floors approach minus one third as the length grows. Every finite length stays above it.
长度增加时，精确下界趋近负三分之一。每个有限长度的下界都比它高。
Lean verifies the three-measurement refutation. The all-length argument is in the paper by Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang.
Lean 验证三次测量推翻下界的结论。任意长度的证明见 Haobo Ma 与 Wenlin Zhang 的论文。
